QuestInfo.name: Porchay's Letter
QuestInfo.0: Porchay, who stays with the Whalians in the Generator Room, says that there is an emergency. I wonder what it is.
QuestInfo.1: I can't believe that the Whalians have completely run out of food! According to Porchay, Kenta has plenty of food ingredients so I should go to #bKenta#k and talk to her. I should take Porchay's letter with me too, right?
QuestInfo.2: I gave Porchay's letter to Kenta.

0.0: Hello, traveler? Are you here at the Generator Room to see this rock? Isn't Shining Stone amazing? And the Whalians that control the rock... they're amazing too, right?
0.1: Since you've made your way all the way down here, can I ask you for a favor? Not many people pass through this area, and we're in a bit of trouble right now.

yes.0: The Whalians here don't eat what the normal people eat. They eat something that can only be found in the sea. They always ate that, but... now that we've spent a considerable amount of time here on land, the ingredients have run out.
yes.1: My cousin Kenta, who lives in Aquarium, can make something for them. That's why I am here to ask you for a favor. Can you send this letter that I wrote about that food to #bKenta#k? You can find him at the Aquarium Zoo.

no.0: I guess you don't have time to help me. Who should I ask, then?

1.0: You're here to give me a letter? It's from Porchay?

yes.0: Oh... so it's about the special food that the Whalians eat. They only eat certain things, so... let's see if there's any left.

npc.0: You can find Kenta at the Aquarium.

item.0: Kenta is at the Aquarium Zoo, watching over the animals.

lost.0: Did you lose the letter? Oh no... I'll write you another one. Don't lose it again, okay?

yes.0: Now, please give this letter to Kenta.
